title: Infrastructure bottleneck audit (outside ERP application)

context.user_symptom: several seconds before ERP usable after login

single_biggest_bottleneck.component: DNS resolution via Hetzner recursive resolvers (production /etc/resolv.conf nameservers 2a01:4ff:ff00::add:1 and ::add:2)
single_biggest_bottleneck.percentage_of: cold public HTTPS request total time from the production host (curl https://rateb.sa/... without --resolve)
evidence: dig @2a01:4ff:ff00::add:2 rateb.sa → Query time 1452 ms (try1), 1451 ms (try3)
curl public1: dns=1.460498s ttfb=1.585412s total=1.585525s (DNS = 92.1% of TTFB)
curl public2: dns=1.476251s ttfb=1.575635s total=1.575738s (DNS = 93.7% of total)
Same URLs with --resolve rateb.sa:443:167.233.71.107: admin TTFB 80–151 ms (app+FPM path healthy once DNS skipped)

layer_audit_summary.1_DNS: CRITICAL — cold lookups ~1450–1550 ms to Hetzner resolvers; dominates any client (incl. server-local curl) that resolves rateb.sa
layer_audit_summary.2_TCP: OK when IP known — loopback/resolve path tcp <1 ms; client WAN tcp ~100–110 ms
layer_audit_summary.3_TLS: OK — ~9–23 ms server-local; ~110–120 ms from Windows client
layer_audit_summary.4_HTTP_keepalive: HTTP/2 on server (ALPN); client curl.exe negotiated HTTP/1.1
layer_audit_summary.5_Reverse_proxy: Apache/2 — healthy; not the multi-second cost once DNS resolved
layer_audit_summary.6_7_PHP_FPM: pm=ondemand, max_children=10, idle_timeout=20s; workers_before=0 → spawn on demand; cold admin TTFB 151 ms vs warm 81 ms (spawn ~70 ms) — secondary
layer_audit_summary.8_OPcache: DISABLED — php.ini:976 `;zend_extension=opcache`; FPM probe opcache_loaded=false — secondary (explains AB Bootstrap 30 ms, not multi-second alone)
layer_audit_summary.10_RAM: 7.3 Gi total, ~5 Gi available — no pressure
layer_audit_summary.15_Slow_query_log: OFF — no evidence of SQL as UX limiter
layer_audit_summary.17_18_Compression: gzip active for CSS (Content-Encoding: gzip; main.css 9949→2125)
layer_audit_summary.22_Service_Worker: pos-sw.js active for entire /rateb-erp/public/ scope; online path bypasses intercept (fromServiceWorker=false) — not the 1.4s DNS class cost
layer_audit_summary.23_Browser_waterfall: login→first spin-free poll 2224 ms; usableAtMs 4621 includes +~1.5s network-quiet heuristic
layer_audit_summary.24_Largest_JS: rateb-offline.min.js 387051 bytes; client download total ~732 ms
layer_audit_summary.27_Third_party: no third-party origins in top slow resources (all first-party rateb.sa)
layer_audit_summary.28_Connection_reuse: HTTP/2 multiplexing on server; browser keep-alive after login page

server_waterfall_bypass_dns_ms.note: Application path is tens–low hundreds of ms once DNS is eliminated

verdict: PASS_IDENTIFIED — DNS recursion via Hetzner resolvers is the single largest outside-app wall (~1.45–1.55 s, ~94% of cold public request).
